null_family_paired_bootstrap_from_previo.result: the F2->A0 delta-AUC CIs for null_score / cls_start_logit / cls_end_logit all included zero
null_family_paired_bootstrap_from_previo.relation: that earlier result concerns the NULL family; this phase analyses the answer-span family (margin, best_answer_score), whose AUC difference is much larger, and asks whether the remaining difference survives single-example influence analysis

does_remaining_auc_difference_survive_in.note: disjoint leave-one-out ranges mean no single-example removal can close the gap; this is a descriptive influence statement, not a significance test

task_14_answers.A_is_A0_margin_broad_or_artifact: A0 margin AUC 0.5432 is stable and near chance rather than an artifact of a few examples: its jackknife range is [0.5321, 0.5564] with 100.00% of leave-one-out runs above 0.5 and no side flip (classification NEAR_CHANCE_STABLE); the largest single-example removal moves AUC by only 0.0132
task_14_answers.B_is_F2_margin_distributed: yes: F2 margin AUC 0.7338 has jackknife range [0.7274, 0.7517] (width 0.0244), 100.00% of leave-one-out runs stay above 0.5 (side flips: 0), the largest single removal changes AUC by 0.0179, and the top 50% of answerable examples carry only 0.7139 of the answerable-side absolute influence
task_14_answers.C_same_examples_driving_both: no — cross-checkpoint influence agreement is weak: margin influence Spearman -0.1370 with top-10 overlap 1/10 (Jaccard 0.0526) and top-20 overlap 3/20 (Jaccard 0.0811); best_answer_score influence Spearman -0.1428
task_14_answers.D_where_the_difference_lives: margin: DISTRIBUTED_DIFFERENCE (top-10 share 0.139, top-20 share 0.2661, class ratio 1.1568); best_answer_score: DISTRIBUTED_DIFFERENCE (top-10 share 0.1307, top-20 share 0.2493, class ratio 1.0994)
task_14_answers.E_answer_span_still_stronger: yes: after influence decomposition the answer-span family remains far stronger than the null family at F2 (margin 0.7338 and best_answer_score 0.7250, both BROAD-distributed across leave-one-out removals), while at A0 both are near chance (margin 0.5432, best_answer_score 0.5054)

definitions.INFLUENCE_DISTRIBUTED: AUC interpretation remains materially similar after single-example removal and influence is spread broadly
definitions.INFLUENCE_CONCENTRATED: a small number of examples materially determine the observed separation
definitions.INFLUENCE_MIXED: one checkpoint/statistic is broad while another is concentrated
definitions.INFLUENCE_INCONCLUSIVE: the influence decomposition cannot distinguish the mechanisms

rule.INFLUENCE_DISTRIBUTED: every target stability class is BROAD_DISTRIBUTED_SIGNAL or NEAR_CHANCE_STABLE (no small subset determines the separation)
rule.INFLUENCE_CONCENTRATED: at least one target is FEW_EXAMPLES_DRIVE_SIGNAL and none is BROAD_DISTRIBUTED_SIGNAL
rule.INFLUENCE_MIXED: at least one target is FEW_EXAMPLES_DRIVE_SIGNAL while at least one is BROAD_DISTRIBUTED_SIGNAL

task_15_verdict.mechanistic_note: the only target classified A0|best_answer_score has |AUC - 0.5| = 0.0054 (statistically indistinguishable from chance); its 12 side-flipping leave-one-out runs all come from unanswerable removals (12 of 42; answerable removals: 0 of 140), the deepest any single removal pushes the AUC below 0.5 is 0.006620 (jackknife min 0.4934), and the largest single change in AUC is delta_max 0.012328. This is chance-boundary instability of a statistic that sits on 0.5, not evidence that a small subset creates a separation.
task_15_verdict.alternative_reading: if CONCENTRATED is required to mean that a material separation is produced by a small subset, then no target qualifies: the F2 targets carry |AUC - 0.5| > 0.22 broadly across examples (top-1 example = 1.1-3.7% of absolute influence), and the A0 target that triggered FEW_EXAMPLES sits on 0.5 (|AUC - 0.5| = 0.0054, deepest single-removal excursion below 0.5 only 0.0066). Under that reading every target falls in BROAD_DISTRIBUTED_SIGNAL or NEAR_CHANCE_STABLE, i.e. INFLUENCE_DISTRIBUTED. The applied verdict follows the pre-declared rule mechanically; this alternative is reported so the label is not read as evidence of a concentrated signal that does not exist.

interpretation_boundary: No model loading, no inference, no training, no GPU, no database, no retrieval was used.
No threshold was fitted, no K searched, no subset optimization, no leave-two-out or combinatorial search, no new or combined score was created.
Only recorded score fields and labels were re-analysed mathematically; the frozen prediction artifact was not modified.
Influence and jackknife figures are descriptive decompositions of a rank statistic, not causal effects and not architectural evidence.
No winner/best/superior language is used; each checkpoint/statistic is reported on its own measurements.
